newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets second round of specials.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets second round of specials.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Friday set a second round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.25 percent, traders said.
Dealers said the Bank of Canada intervened after the call loan rate traded to the top of the central bank's 2.75-3.25 percent target range.
"There's no change in policy. It's month end and there's probably some tightness in the system," said a T-bill trader with one bank-owned brokerage. "There's nothing to be alarmed about."
The three-month cash T-bill traded with a yield of 2.96 percent in the wake of the intervention.
